translations.web: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
translations.bsb: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof; the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
